query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `backups` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `filename` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `filepath` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `filesize` int NOT NULL,
  `backup_type` enum('manual','scheduled','automatic') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
  `status` enum('pending','completed','failed','restoring') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `created_by` int NOT NULL,
  `error_message` text,
  `restored_at` timestamp NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `backups_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `backup_schedules` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `is_enabled` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `frequency` enum('daily','weekly','monthly') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'daily',
  `schedule_time` varchar(5) NOT NULL DEFAULT '03:00',
  `day_of_week` int NULL,
  `day_of_month` int NULL,
  `retention_days` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 7,
  `last_run_at` timestamp NULL,
  `next_run_at` timestamp NULL,
  `created_by` int NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `backup_schedules_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
